trace.notes: Normalized the input as an Academia scholarly article page for the work titled 'Open Problems and Conjectures'.

Primary Academia URL exposed only a landing page with metadata, abstract text, and AI-generated FAQ content; it did not expose readable full article text or a downloadable PDF artifact through the available fetch methods. Direct HEAD access returned HTTP 403. DOI 10.1080/10236190410001726449 resolved to Taylor & Francis metadata for Journal of Difference Equations and Applications, and OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false with no repository full text. Exact-work recovery attempts using the title, author, and DOI returned only the same Academia landing page, a Digital Commons metadata page marked 'This document is currently not available here', a 403 Taylor & Francis abstract page, and other metadata-only references. Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source was recovered, so extraction was not attempted.
